cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Hide Inside the Callback
cards.instruction: Use an early harmless detail as the explanation for each new consequence, keeping your own role outside the pattern.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll get this tent corner up. That little ribbon made the rope look like a pull cord.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You tied the ribbon on it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll untie it. Hold the pole for me; without the ribbon, nobody will mistake it again.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Nobody else pulled it. You did.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then I'll take the pole. You remove the ribbon before it gives anyone else the same idea.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 runs tent recovery while blaming ribbon; A3 promises removal and A5 swaps jobs to keep B helping without accepting agency for the pull.

responseLogic.evidence: B2 attachment accusation makes A3 offer untying; B4 identifies A as puller and A5 moves A to pole while assigning B removal.

relationship.evidence: B2 and B4 refuse inaccurate general blame but remain available for the practical repair.

heightening.evidence: A5 absorbs B4 identifying A by repeating the same misleading-decoration cause and changing who handles it.

specificity.evidence: A1 tent corner down and rope/ribbon, A3 supporting pole, identify a workable repair proposal.

brevityWit.evidence: A5 practical reassignment and repeated ribbon warning demonstrate evasion without analysing it.
